scope: Official-source review and GPX version status for top-level events 101–110
safety: Keep all existing GPX files until an official replacement is downloaded, parsed and validated.
Do not overwrite/delete older course files when a new edition is announced.
A GPX download link is not proof that its binary has been parsed or its track metrics validated.

events.name: Alpin Team Trailrun
events.gpxStatus: Official page still shows 25–26 September 2026 and downloadable GPX for 2026 routes; no 2027 date/file confirmed.
events.detail: Do not treat current page or GPX links as 2027. Keep the 2026 tracks labelled historical/current edition until organizer announces next date.

events.name: Chihuahua by UTMB
events.date: No 2027 edition listed; official page remains 1–3 October 2026
events.gpxStatus: 2026 programme only; no 2027 edition or 2027 GPX verified.
events.detail: UTMB page continues to show the 2026 event and six races. No 2027 Chihuahua date is published; retain old course files as 2026 only.

events.name: Trail & Tarmac Pursuit
events.gpxStatus: 2027 event confirmed; no single official GPX by design because teams plan their own route and checkpoint 6 is revealed 30 minutes before start.
events.detail: Five checkpoints are released in the months before the race; final secret checkpoint is disclosed at 16:30 on 1 October 2027. App should model this as a self-planned route event, not a fixed course with one organizer GPX.

events.name: Oberaudorf Trail Festival
events.gpxStatus: Official 2027 event programme confirmed; direct GPX endpoints were not validated as official 2027 files. Third-party search result lists candidate downloads, including an OTF26 filename for the 100km file; treat as stale/unverified.
events.detail: Official programme confirms 2027 event dates and five races. Candidate links surfaced outside organizer site include 12.4K/24K/42.8K/56.5K and an OTF26 100K file; do not import until each official organizer route page confirms edition/version.

events.name: Taubertal 100
events.gpxStatus: 2027 date appears in event calendars; organizer GPS page still marked 17.08.2026 and offers 2026 files only.
events.detail: Important distinction: this app entry is Taubertal 100 (ultramarathon starting Rothenburg), not the separate Taubertal Trail event in Adelshofen. Do not substitute Taubertal Trail GPX files. Await 2027 Taubertal 100 organizer files.

events.name: HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB

events.gpxStatus: 2027 registration information is live, but accessible course pages/GPX still refer to 2026 edition.
events.detail: 2027 event is confirmed at registration page; wait for 2027 course pages and individual track releases. Do not reuse 2026 GPX.

events.name: München Marathon
events.date: 2027 event/course date not yet confirmed on GPX page
events.gpxStatus: Official GPX download page explicitly names 11 October 2026 and offers marathon, half-marathon and 10K files only for 2026.
events.detail: Organizer notes GPS/GPX distances may differ from certified road-race measurement by around 1–2%; do not treat GPS track measurement as the certified course length. Wait for 2027 download page.

events.name: StundenRundenLauf (Chiemgauer100)
events.gpxStatus: Official announcement only confirms the event's return in 2026; no 2027 edition or GPX release found.
events.detail: 2026 event page confirms 6.7km loop and approx. 58hm. Do not project this route into 2027 without organizer confirmation.

events.name: Kullamannen by UTMB
events.gpxStatus: 2027 date and four race distances/elevation values officially published; individual Map + GPX files not downloaded or parsed in this pass.
events.detail: Official event page shows 5–6 November 2027. The current race naming and distances differ from the old checkpoint's generic 100M/100K/50K/20K labels; update labels only after checking each route page.

events.name: Mallorca Serra de Tramuntana by UTMB
events.date: No 2027 edition confirmed; official page lists 2026 only
events.gpxStatus: 2026 tracks only; no 2027 event or GPX confirmed.
events.detail: Do not use 2026 track files as 2027 routes. Recheck only after official UTMB event calendar lists a new Mallorca edition.

notable: Trail & Tarmac Pursuit is a self-planned 240–270km relay with six checkpoints, not a fixed GPX course.
Oberaudorf Trail Festival has official 2027 programme and five race formats; candidate direct GPX links surfaced externally are not yet validated as 2027 organizer files.
Taubertal 100 must not be confused with Taubertal Trail in Adelshofen.
Kullamannen 2027 official route page now specifies 168/108/53/22km with respective elevation values.
Alpin Team Trail, Chihuahua, StundenRundenLauf and Mallorca have no confirmed 2027 edition/course files in current official sources.
